metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected from five participants (sub-01 to sub-05) across 5-6 sessions per participant. Raw data are provided in EDF format, with preprocessed derivatives available in fif and pkl formats. Text stimuli used to elicit imagined speech responses are included in the dataset. Participants sub-01 to sub-03 conform to BIDS 1.6.0 protocol. Supplementary data from sub-04 and sub-05 follow an earlier BIDS protocol version to preserve compatibility with existing data processing code from related publications.
